mapper.select: SELECT s.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, s.status AS status, s.start_date AS startDate, s.end_date AS endDate, s.auto_renew AS autoRenew, p.plan_name AS planName, p.plan_type AS planType, p.price AS price, p.features AS features, DATEDIFF(s.end_date, CURDATE()) AS daysLeft FROM subscriptions s JOIN subscription_plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.end_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY s.end_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT py.payment_id AS paymentId, py.amount AS amount, py.status AS status, py.paid_at AS paidAt, py.created_at AS createdAt, p.plan_name AS planName, p.plan_type AS planType FROM payments py LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON py.subscription_id = s.subscription_id LEFT JOIN subscription_plans p ON s.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE py.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY py.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
